verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents basic file CRUD via the SharePoint REST interface and read-write driveItems via Microsoft Graph. It never mentions chunked uploads, upload sessions, or resuming a transfer after a dropped connection. Basic file CRUD is an adjacent capability and earns no credit toward resumable big-file uploads.

support.subject: As a developer, big files upload reliably — documented chunked/resumable upload sessions that survive a dropped connection
